title: Biocompatibility Analyses of HF-Passivated Magnesium Screws for Guided Bone Regeneration (GBR)
authors: Ole Jung, Bernhard Hesse, Sanja Stojanovic, Christian Seim, Timm Weitkamp, Milijana Batinic, Oliver Goerke, Željka Perić Kačarević, Patrick Rider, Stevo Najman, and Mike Barbeck. 2021. International Journal of Molecular Sciences 22(22). doi: 10.3390/ijms222212567. Relevant Publications - NOVAMag® membrane and NOVAMag® fixation screw
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss NOVAMag (magnesium membrane, screw, SHIELD) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Overall, the HF-passivated Mg fixation screws showed significantly better biocompatibility in vitro and in vivo compared to the untreated screws” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
